blur_detection.description: The invoice displays crisp, well-defined text with excellent edge definition throughout the document.
blur_detection.recommendation: No action needed; current sharpness is suitable for OCR processing.

contrast_assessment.description: The invoice exhibits excellent black text on white background contrast with clear differentiation between elements.
contrast_assessment.recommendation: Maintain current scanning/photography settings for future documents.

glare_identification.description: No visible glare, reflections, or overexposed areas detected on the invoice surface.
glare_identification.recommendation: Continue using current lighting conditions for document capture.

water_stains.description: No water damage, discoloration, or staining visible on any part of the invoice.
water_stains.recommendation: Continue maintaining document in dry conditions.

tears_or_folds.description: The invoice appears flat with no visible creases, folds, tears, or physical damage.
tears_or_folds.recommendation: Continue current handling and storage practices to maintain document integrity.

cut_off_detection.description: All invoice edges are fully visible with adequate margins around the content.
cut_off_detection.recommendation: Maintain current scanning frame positioning for complete document capture.

missing_sections.description: The invoice appears complete with all expected sections present including header, customer details, line items, and totals.
missing_sections.recommendation: No action needed; document completeness is excellent.

obstructions.description: No fingers, shadows, or other obstructions blocking any part of the invoice content.
obstructions.recommendation: Continue current capturing technique to maintain obstruction-free images.
